Account: {0}
Target: {1}

Save your work and close your apps first. After all 44 checks pass, Windows will sign you out automatically, with no further prompt. Canceling or a failed operation will not sign you out.

Setup creates the 12 UserSpace folders and moves existing files from Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Music, Pictures and Videos to their matching folders. A name conflict stops the operation and keeps both copies.

Setup saves the current settings and icon metadata, updates the Windows folder locations, and checks them in a new process. The other six preset folders are created only if missing.

Old folders remain available for later cleanup. OneDrive and other custom redirects require separate handling. Apps using fixed paths may continue to use the old locations.
